description: Starts a NEW collaboration from scratch and connects this session to it. Returns a Code and a Password: show both to the user verbatim, they are needed by every teammate and the password is shown only once.

device.description: Optional name of this computer, shown to teammates (ask the user; the host name is not sent). Without one the session gets a short id. Tells one person's sessions on different machines apart.

name.description: Name of the collaboration, e.g. Checkout service review.

replace.description: Only after the user agreed to replace an existing connection.

role.description: What this session works on in the collaboration: backend, frontend, tests, ...

tool.description: The AI tool this session runs in: claude-code, codex, opencode, ...

yourName.description: What teammates should call this session or its user, e.g. Burak.

name: meshingly_create
